short_description: Zorvak style, a herd of pale deer gathered around a large bare tree in a misty, dark landscape with distant hills and huts.

objects.location: foreground, clustered around the base of the tree
objects.relationship: standing on the ground, facing various directions
objects.shape_and_color: pale beige and white bodies with dark brown patches on their backs
objects.appearance_details: slender legs, small antlers on some individuals
objects.pose: standing still, some with heads turned

objects.relationship: providing a central anchor for the deer herd
objects.shape_and_color: grey-brown trunk and branches, sparse green foliage on the left side
objects.appearance_details: twisted branches extending upwards and outwards, bare branches on the right side

background_setting: A dark, misty landscape with a flat field in the middle ground, a line of dark trees and hills in the distance, and small white huts nestled among the trees. The sky is a deep blue-black with faint white specks suggesting stars or snow.

lighting.shadows: Soft, indistinct shadows beneath the deer and tree

aesthetics.composition: Vertical composition with the tree on the left and the deer herd in the lower center, balancing the dark sky above
